identity_rules.ret-copy-chain: call <alloc>; mov r,eax (or mov eax,r) chains; any call kills eax/ecx/edx, callee-saved regs survive (MSVC6 ABI). Value identity is liveness-independent: an intermediate register need not be dead, only unmodified on the path.
identity_rules.ret-slot-forward: call <alloc>; mov [var_N|arg_N],eax; ...; mov eax,[slot]; ret.  Soundness: the slot must not be address-taken (lea reg,[slot]) and EVERY call invalidates EVERY slot (an untracked callee could alias it); the CFG join requires the same descriptor on every path (an overwrite on any path kills it).
identity_rules.ret-wrapper: call F; ...; ret where every ret of F is NEW|PROVEN|NULL (this same gate) => the caller forwards F's value with no transform.  Closed to a fixpoint, cycle-safe (a function is added at most once; passes stop when nothing is added).
identity_rules.alloc-call-site: EAX:<caller>:<site> for every allocator call whose size argument is proven by A-E (the callee returns the allocation or NULL).  Tagged via=alloc-call-site so a consumer can exclude this channel (R5) without touching RET evidence.
identity_rules.transformed: any add/sub/inc/dec/and/or/xor/shift/neg/not/imul/... on the allocation value breaks identity -> candidate only

meta.soundness_gate: RET evidence requires: >=1 ret site whose eax is exactly an allocator call result (NEW) or a proven wrapper callee's result (PROVEN) and every other ret site is NEW|PROVEN|NULL (xor eax,eax / mov eax,0); size must be proven by A_push_imm / B_mov_imm / C_imul / D_lea_scale / E_shl (or inherited from a proven callee); recorded ret blocks must equal the function's total ret/retn count (CFG complete); Hex-Rays/IDA annotations are never used as evidence.
meta.semantics: sizes/sems carry AV-family semantics: sem=total -> pointee sizeof equals size or divides it; sem=elem -> sizeof equals size. Wiring side computes class candidates from tools/class_layouts.json exactly like the AV family (per-ent OR over observed (size,sem)).
meta.wiring_note: future family (e.g. RN): identical size->mask computation as the AV family (sem=total: sizeof==size or sizeof|size; sem=elem: sizeof==size; per-ent OR over (size,sem) pairs). CRITICAL: entities are pointer VALUES (RET:/EAX:). Under the current axis policy AV sits in _POINTEE_FAMS and all 807 AV masks are axis-dropped on P/M/G/S value entities (see solver log), so copying AV's family placement would make RN inert. Wire RN as a value-axis family (like EP/C10, whose class atoms mean 'pointer to class') or explicitly exempt it. To wire only the RET channel, filter via != 'alloc-call-site'.
meta.candidate_note: candidates are NOT evidence: identity partially proven, transformed, mixed return sites, or size unresolved. detail carries [shape=...] for no-ret-identity records.
